name: Boards and checked pills
what: The room turns to grid paper, two boards of your reels pop onto the wall behind your head, and a cursor clicks blue pills in front of you one after another - each pill pops in, squashes and ticks checked; the cursor slides away, then the pills shrink away and the boards fade.
origin: MotionLab's own build after a design in Vibha Ramprakash's claude-video-effects (MIT), 2026-10-28
motion: f0 and f3 the two boards pop onto the wall from 0.6 (10 f, an overshoot) and then float 4 px and half a degree; the cursor fades in at the lower right and glides to the first pill (f1-f9, S-curve); each pill pops in from 0.5 (7 f, an overshoot) at f5 and then every gap (9) frames, the cursor gliding to it (7 f, S-curve) and pressing 6 frames after the pop (it dips, a ripple spreads 9 f), the pill squashing, widening (5 f, slow end) and its tick drawing (5 f); 12 f after the last click the cursor slides away and fades (14 f, S-curve); the pills bob 2 px out of step; the last 9 f the pills shrink away one after another and the boards fade and sink (accelerating). With the default four pills: clicks at f11, f20, f29, f38.

min_frames: round((11 + (max(1, min(6, parts(pills))) - 1) * max(4, gap) + 34) * fps / 30)
min_why: every pill is clicked and seen ticked before the boards and pills leave
